headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Dated: 06 Nov 2026 Rationale: • Aadhar remains perhaps the most consistent affordable HFC with predictable outcomes. • The company is well placed on margins, while the impact of changes in disbursement recognition norms should reverse in 2HFY27, enabling loan growth to catch up. • Asset quality has weakened modestly, which we look through for now. • Retain BUY with an FV of Rs650.
